title: State versus private universities in Türkiye
excerpt: The practical differences between state and foundation universities in Türkiye: cost, language of instruction, admission route, and who each one actually suits.

children.text: The headline difference is cost. State university tuition sits far below private tuition, and for many families that alone decides the question.

The less obvious differences matter too. State universities more often teach in Turkish, which means a language year for most international students, and their admission routes more often involve an entrance examination.
